tokenForm.lede: Tools for your agents to find, run and follow Rundeck jobs.

checks.name: allow_insecure_private_http
checks.label: Allow plain HTTP on a private network

otherWay.offer: Use a username and password instead

tools.name: rundeck_projects
tools.description: The Rundeck projects the person can see.

tools.name: rundeck_jobs
tools.description: Jobs by full group/name path, with ids and options: required, default, allowed values. A filter that matches nothing answers with the closest paths.

filter.description: Text in the job's path, any case.

tools.name: rundeck_run
tools.description: Run a job and wait up to 50s for it to end: status, duration, url, last log lines. Still running? rundeck execution with wait.

project.description: Where to find job. Default: every project.

wait.description: Default true; false answers with the execution id at once.

production.description: True only after the person agreed to run this production job.

tools.name: rundeck_export
tools.description: A job's whole definition as Rundeck's JSON, and its revision for rundeck edit. Too long an answer is cut; omitted names the file holding it whole.

project.description: Where to find job. Default: every project.

tools.name: rundeck_import
tools.description: Replace a job's whole definition, keeping its uuid. To change only parts of it, use rundeck edit.

project.description: Where to find job. Default: every project.

definition.description: The whole job, as export gives it.

production.description: True only after the person agreed to change this production job.

tools.name: rundeck_edit
tools.description: Change parts of a job and leave the rest as it is. Refused if the job changed since that revision.

project.description: Where to find job. Default: every project.

revision.description: From rundeck export, or the last edit.

op.description: add puts value in before that list position. replaceText swaps old for value inside one text.

path.description: Such as /sequence/commands/2; /- is a list's end.

value.description: A step, a field, or text.

production.description: True only after the person agreed to change this production job.

tools.name: rundeck_executions
tools.description: Runs, newest first, with status, branch, user and duration. With neither job nor project, what is running now.

tools.name: rundeck_execution
tools.description: One run: status, the options it ran with, timings and url. wait holds up to 50s for it to end and adds its last log lines.

wait.description: Hold up to 50s for it to end.

tools.name: rundeck_logs
tools.description: The end of a run's output, after grep. truncated means earlier lines were left out.

grep.description: Only lines containing this, any case.

tools.name: rundeck_plan
tools.description: Before deploying a branch: what the job last deployed, the option carrying the branch, and whether the checkout is clean, pushed and contains it.

project.description: Where to find job. Default: every project.
